rtp.label: RTP
rtp.hint: 0.99 = 99%. The upper bound 0.99 is a mathematical ceiling: at rtp >= 1.0 the player's expected value is no longer negative. The lower bound 0.90 is set by the platform contract.

target_min.label: Minimum target
target_min.hint: Shown to the player as 2.00 when the value is 200.

target_max.label: Maximum target
target_max.hint: Shown to the player as 98.00 when the value is 9800.

default_target.label: Default target
default_target.hint: Must lie between Minimum target and Maximum target — otherwise the model fails to start.
